candidate_hypothesis.text: Same-input FP32 GDN comparisons are the local contraction-order control; the full-model BF16 comparison includes recurrence, BF16 boundary casts and sparse routing. First top2 route-set mismatch is at block 2, logical pass 1, with 3 of 512 valid positions. Teacher-forced scan-selected routes changed the maximum logits rel-L2 from 0.0322755 to 0.00859061 (ratio 0.266); this is an intervention result, not proof of a first cause.

key_findings: Exact T0025 reproduction: scan losses and identity exact; chunk64 loss deltas 0.0; per-key routing counts exact; tensor metrics exact.
Corrected token-weighted top2 routing disagreement is 34/4096 = 0.00830078125 overall; pass 1 is 5/2048 and pass 2 is 29/2048.
Same-input FP32 delta_scan vs delta_chunk64 is local-only: max output/state rel-L2 3.696e-7 and max abs 1.192e-7; FP64 oracle passed.
FP32 full-model scan/chunk routing is exact; tensor rel-L2 is about 1e-6 and max abs about 3.2e-6. The algorithm difference is tiny without BF16 casts.

In BF16, the first GDN-local output difference is block 0/pass 1 (3.941e-7 rel); the first propagated GDN-input difference is block 1/pass 1 (2.159e-4 rel); the first top2 route-set mismatch is block 2/pass 1 (3/512).
Per-pass BF16 divergence grows: GDN delta-output max rel 7.058e-3 (pass 1) to 4.792e-2 (pass 2); GDN input max rel 1.973e-3 to 2.771e-2; router-logit max rel 1.569e-2 to 3.529e-2.

At the first route mismatch, the flipped second expert is close to the third: scan top2-minus-top3 median 6.515e-4 and candidate 1.022e-3; scan top1 remains rank 0 in the candidate and scan top2 becomes rank 2 for all three mismatched tokens.

Teacher-forced scan-selected routes reduce worst logits rel-L2 from 3.228e-2 to 8.591e-3 (ratio 0.266), and all fixed-route tensor deltas fall within the T0025 tensor gates; this is a diagnostic intervention, not production routing or exact equivalence.
limitations: One synthetic contiguous T512 invocation and one seed; no training, backward, optimizer step or checkpoint.
No actual data, quality, throughput, energy or resource-speed claim.
Local GDN comparison is same-input FP32; full-model BF16/FP32 comparisons include propagation through different recurrence/routing states.
Teacher-forced routes are a diagnostic intervention, not production routing and not an exact-equivalence claim.
Route-flip timing is observational; it does not by itself identify the first causal numerical origin.

requirements: same-input FP32 GDN output and carried state pass rel<=1e-4 and maxabs<=1e-4*max(1,refmax) at every captured block/pass
token-weighted top2 route-set mismatch is zero across all logical passes
natural BF16 hidden/logit/offset2 differences satisfy the existing T0025 tensor gates without relaxation
teacher-forced-route and natural BF16 paths both meet the existing T0025 gates before any T2048/resource qualification
